brief_en: Quiet open to 31 Aug Taipei time. In the last 12 hours, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI and other tracked labs posted no new official model, API, pricing, paper, or product launches. Prior-week items (Cursor wind-down, MHS preview, Grok Bot/X) remain outside this window.
brief_zh: 台北時間 8/31 開盤偏靜。過去 12 小時內，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta、xAI 及其他追蹤實驗室皆無新的官方模型、API、定價、論文或產品發布。上週 Cursor 解約、MHS 預覽、Grok Bot 等不列入本窗。
